incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (Law no. 66-879 of 7 July 1966 on commercial companies, as amended), articles L. 223-1 to L. 238-1
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS - Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Statuts de la Société (Articles of Association)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Minimum capital requirement of 1 euro; no escrow account required; capital must be fully paid up in cash upon subscription and deposited in the company's bank account
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the Company be incorporated as a Société à Responsabilité Limitée (SARL) under French law with a share capital of [Amount] euros, fully subscribed and paid up by the shareholders in cash. The registered office is adopted at [Full French Address]. [Name1] and [Name2] are appointed as gérants with joint and several powers to represent the Company in all acts of management and administration, including signing contracts and opening bank accounts. The Articles of Association are approved and authorized for filing with the RCS. All necessary powers are granted to the gérants for the proper incorporation and initial operations of the Company. This resolution is adopted unanimously by the shareholders.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Shareholders prepare and sign the statuts de la société, including details on capital, purpose, gérants, and governance. The document is then notarized to validate the incorporation.
required_dossiers: Proof of share subscription and capital payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If defects are noted, amend the statuts and resubmit for notarization before filing

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing with the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via guichet-entreprises.fr online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notarized statuts along with the standard incorporation form (D-123 or equivalent) and any supporting proofs to the RCS. Upon approval, the SIREN number is issued, enabling the company to operate legally.
required_dossiers: Proof of capital deposit and shareholder details
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, provide missing documents or request a procedural extension within the SLA period

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: SIREN/SIRET registration serves as the primary business identifier and operating permit

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition écologique et de la Cohésion des territoires
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - No EIA required for retail and e-commerce operations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: General environmental compliance applies; no specific discharge or emissions thresholds for online marketplace FBA activities

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not applicable for Amazon FBA model with no physical premises; if any storage or office is used, obtain fire safety certification and workplace clearance from local authorities

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via the official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must register with the French tax authorities to obtain a SIREN number and VAT identification number (TVA intracommunautaire). The procedure requires submission of incorporation documents, articles of association, and proof of address through the impots.gouv.fr portal, followed by issuance of fiscal identifiers. For Amazon FBA operations, Amazon Seller Central provides compliance reporting tools to support registration.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; French corporate taxation applies at the entity level for SARL. Hybrid mismatch rules are enforced under EU directives and domestic anti-avoidance provisions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory electronic invoicing (facturation électronique) for B2B transactions above thresholds; real-time data transmission to tax authorities via APIs with digital stamping for clearance and audit readiness.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to exports of goods and certain offshore services to non-EU countries, provided the goods are physically exported and proof of export is furnished.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims trigger penalties up to 80% of the VAT amount, plus interest and potential criminal prosecution; retrospective clawback of zero-rated VAT credits if export documentation is not substantiated.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (together with the Direction Générale du Trésor and the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France is a full member of the euro area and maintains fully liberalised currency and capital controls under the Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union. The euro is freely convertible for both current account and capital account transactions. Profit remittances by an SARL in the form of dividends are generally permitted without prior exchange control authorisation, but may be subject to French withholding tax (typically 30% where the EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive does not apply) and to the standard banking documentation evidencing the shareholder distribution (e.g., board minutes, financial statements, and tax attestations). Cross-border remittances above €15,000 are monitored by credit institutions for balance-of-payments statistics and anti-money-laundering purposes, but this does not constitute a convertibility barrier.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: There is no statutory requirement under French law or ECB regulations to surrender export proceeds or to convert them into euros. Export receipts may be retained in foreign currency accounts held with authorised intermediaries (banks established in France or elsewhere in the EU/EEA), or freely sold for euros at negotiated commercial rates. Receipts credited to accounts maintained outside France must be individually declared in the annual 'déclaration de compte à l'étranger' part of the French income or corporate tax return. Banks are required to report cross-border payment data to the Banque de France for statistical purposes under the European Balance of Payments framework, but no conversion or repatriation timeline is mandatory.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for non-core clearing operations, subject to strict limitation. European Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs) such as Airwallex and certain fintech platforms benefit from the EU passporting regime and may hold funds for a French SARL, but they are not licensed deposit-taking banks and do not participate in the French deposit guarantee scheme (FC - FGDR). A French SARL engaged in Amazon FBA cross-border commerce may use such EMIs as settlement sub-'rails' for supplier disbursements and treasury pooling purposes, provided the EMI is properly authorised by its home state regulator and has filed for a French passport under Directive 2009/110/EC. However, for statutory capital compliance, parent-guarantee instruments, and invoicing transactions requiring a French IBAN, a Tier-1 or Tier-2 French credit institution remains the mandatory anchor. The use of an offshore EMI without an EU/EEA passport is legally unviable for receiving French-sourced operational inflows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French AML/KYC regulations (Monetary Code and Financial Code, Article L561-1 et seq.) require the identification of all beneficial owners of a corporate entity, and practical onboarding protocols of French Tier-1 banks normally mandate that the SARL's authorised signatories or the 'gérant' undergo an interaction. Remote opening is increasingly possible for EU-resident signatories using qualified electronic procedures (i.e., verified video identification plus advanced electronic signature), but most Tier-1 French commercial banks for a newly formed SARL with shareholders outside the EU will still require at least one physical visit or a notarised apostilled power of attorney for physically non-present directors. Forecast: physical presence of the authorised gérant or a certified legal representative is strongly recommended for first onboarding; a non-resident shareholder director may mandate a local co-signatory or submit a fully notarised and apostilled proxy.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Foreign ownership from non-EU high-risk jurisdiction or complex multi-layered beneficial ownership structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Authenticated corporate register extracts, ultimate beneficial ownership declaration, proof of economic rationale of the Amazon FBA activity, source of funds documentation for all capital injections and inbound directors' loans, validated passport copies, and a written explanation of the commercial supply chain, supported by Amazon seller central account history.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large initial capital injection from a non-EU shareholder or immediate inbound transfer from a third-party country exceeding €50,000
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed shareholder loan agreements or capital increase resolution, bank statements and credit/debit dossier of the remitting shareholder, tax residence certificates, trade contract evidence (invoices, POs, Amazon fee statements), and a live description of the cross-border inventory financing.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discrepancy between recorded business registration category (ISIC 4791 internet retail) and significant payments to unrelated manufacturers/suppliers in high-risk jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Copy of the Amazon FBA marketplace partnership agreement, seller central dashboards showing product listings and revenue streams, inventory storage contracts, customs import/export documents, supplier due diligence files, and a cash-flow reconciliation breakdown for every outbound trade disbursement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of a fintech or electronic money institution as an operational settlement account, creating an ambiguous 'intermediary risk' profile
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully executed EMI service agreement, regulatory authorisation certificate of the EMI, contractual flow chart of funds, complete AML/KYC file of each counterparty, and a commitment letter stating that all invoices and statutory filings are administered from the primary French bank account.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions and shareholder loans must be executed by conventional SWIFT MT103 or SEPA CT (for euro within the SEPA zone) directly into the SARL's French operating bank account. The beneficiary bank will require the beneficial owner and the transaction 'purpose code' to be accurately declared. For equity subscriptions, the transfer reference should read 'Apport en capital – Fondateur' and be accompanied by a resolution of the shareholders (PV d'AG) and a certificate from the gérant (attestation de dépôt des fonds) proving the share premium and the nominal contribution. For shareholder loans, the wire narrative must be tagged 'Compte courant d'associé' and supported by a formal advance agreement, a liquidity plan, and an amortisation schedule. French banks will conduct a funds-origin validation step; therefore, the remitting bank must include a full sender reference (name, address, account number) and the SARL must file the mandatory 'Déclaration de mouvement de fonds' if the transaction qualifies under anti-money-laundering thresholds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trusted supplier payments and the refinancing of cross-border commercial debt are cleared via SWIFT MT103 for US-dollar-denominated, pound-sterling, or other non-euro settlements; for euro supplies to EU counterparties, SEPA Instant/Restricted Transfer rails are the preferred low-cost route. For major import transactions with manufacturing partners where the SARL negotiates better trade terms, a Commercial Letter of Credit (under UCP600) opened by the French bank is used. All outbound trade disbursements must be accompanied by underlying commercial documentation (purchase orders, supplier invoices, transport and customs documentation when applicable, and Amazon payment settlement statements). For payments above €10,000, bank approval for 'BOP code' declaration under the Banque de France reporting regime is required. Amazon FBA fees and storage charges are usually debited automatically by Amazon from the seller's disbursement account; the SARL must maintain adequate local, SEPA, and SWIFT liquidity buffers to cover both supplier and Amazon fee cycles without triggering overdraft breaches.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forward Outrights (plain vanilla forward contracts on EUR/USD and EUR/GBP) with a French counterparty bank
FX Swaps for short-term treasury liquidity and inventory cycle management
Cross-Currency Interest Rate Swaps (fixed or floating, on eligible euro and foreign-currency balance sheet exposures)
EUR/USD, EUR/GBP Currency Options (vanilla options held by the treasury function, subject to board approval and non-speculative underlying exposure)
Rolling FX hedges using a layered maturity ladder, with maximum tenor of 24 months aligned to Amazon FBA inventory cycle

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual ordinary shareholders' approval of SARL financial statements (Assemblée Générale Ordinaire Annuelle; approval of comptes annuels and proposed profit appropriation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General meeting of shareholders; records kept in the statutory minute book (no external filing at this step)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than 6 months after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year SARL, by 30 June following the close
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No administrative fine at the meeting stage; any shareholder may petition the commercial court for appointment of a mandated agent to convene the meeting, and directors risk personal and civil liability for persistent failure to hold the approval meeting.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual accounts and reports filed with the RCS (dépôt des comptes annuels au Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce via INPI (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 1 month after shareholder approval; approval must occur within 6 months after year-end. Calendar-year SARL: 31 July following the fiscal close, absent court-ordered extension.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Interested parties may apply to the president of the commercial court for an injunction with coercive penalty; default exposes representatives to a criminal fine of up to EUR 9,000; repeated non-filing may culminate in court-ordered filing and, in cases of inactive companies, administrative strike-off from the RCS.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual confirmation and, if required, update of the beneficial-owner declaration (déclaration de bénéficiaires effectifs / RBE file)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / INPI; beneficial-owner register attached to the RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Confirmed with the annual accounts deposit; standalone update within 30 days after any transfer or change of beneficial ownership above 25% of capital or voting rights or change of control. Calendar-year SARL: 31 July following fiscal close.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate administrative fee when filed with accounts; false or incomplete RBE declarations expose the representative to French Monetary and Financial Code criminal penalties, including imprisonment of up to 6 months and fines of up to EUR 18,000; non-compliance is referred by the Greffe to the public prosecutor.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés, IS) under Article 219 CGI for fiscal years beginning on or after 1 January 2022; fiscal year 2024 rate: 25%. Qualifying SMEs may apply a reduced 15% rate to the first €42,500 of taxable profit; balance taxed at 25%.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% SME rate (turnover ≤ €10,000,000, share capital fully paid up, capital ≥75% held by individuals or by an SME satisfying the same conditions); Research Tax Credit (CIR) at 30% of eligible R&D expenditure up to €100,000,000 and 5% above; Innovation Tax Credit (CII) at 20% of eligible innovation expenses up to €400,000; Jeune Entreprise Innovante (JEI) status grants full CIT exemption for the first 3 years and 50% exemption for the next 2 years; régime mère-fille participation exemption (95% of qualifying dividends exempt); contribution sociale sur les bénéfices (3.3% surcharge) applies only where turnover exceeds €7,630,000 and annual corporate tax exceeds €763,000.
